description: This file defines the WebKit class extending BrowserType, implementing methods for connecting, environment setup, logging, closing, and argument preparation for the WebKit browser in Playwright.

classes.name: WebKit
classes.description: Represents the WebKit browser type with methods for connection, environment modification, log rewriting, graceful shutdown, and argument generation.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Connects to a WebKit browser instance via transport.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for WebKit startup.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to include error message if display cannot be opened.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to close the browser gracefully.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching WebKit with specified options.
